meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按 DNAnexus 的 dx CLI/dxpy 规范行动:生成上传下载命令、编写 app/applet 源码与 dxapp.json、运行和监测任务、搭建工作流,并处理 FASTQ/BAM/VCF 等生物信息文件。
howto.when: 当请求涉及 DNAnexus 平台操作时触发,例如创建或修改 app/applet、上传下载或搜索数据、运行或监控任务与工作流等。

say.text: 创建一个处理 FASTQ 的 applet,输入 reads,输出过滤后的结果。
say.note: 会生成 applet 源码和 dxapp.json。

say.text: 查找项目中所有 BAM 文件并下载到本地。
say.note: 会输出 dxpy 查找和下载命令。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude operates DNAnexus according to dx CLI/dxpy conventions: writes upload/download commands, builds app/applet code and dxapp.json, runs and monitors jobs, creates workflows, and handles bioinformatics files such as FASTQ, BAM, and VCF.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the request involves DNAnexus operations, such as creating or modifying apps/applets, uploading/downloading/searching data, or running and monitoring jobs and workflows.

say_en.text: Write a dxpy script to upload sample.fastq to project project-xxxx.
say_en.note: Generates an upload script using DNAnexus APIs.

say_en.text: Create an applet that takes FASTQ reads and outputs filtered results.
Find all BAM files in the project and download them locally.
say_en.note: Outputs dxpy search and download commands.
